item.title: RAWS customers concerned over NCWCID #3 arsenic levels in interconnected supply
item.description: A Calallen neighbor switched to bottled water for drinking, cooking, and pets after an arsenic violation at River Acres Water Supply, which gets its water from NCWCID #3 through an interconnect line.

item.title: Javlinas improve win streak to 9 games after sweeping Texas Woman's 3-1 and 9-1
item.description: In game 1 vs. TWU, Bishop grad Andrea Martinez dealt 3 strikeouts, allowing 3 hits, 1 run and 2 walks in 7 innings. Calallen grad Megan Geyer hit an RBI double in the first frame. #RecruitTheCoast

item.title: Miller secures must-win game in UIL District 29-5A play-in, making a 69-60 comeback against Carroll
item.description: Miller battled back late in the fourth quarter on Friday, upsetting Carroll 69-60 in the UIL District 29-5A must-win play-in game to make playoffs. #RecruitTheCoast
